verdict.rationale: PayPal's agentic-commerce surfaces (Store Sync, cart API, agent toolkit, MCP server) are PayPal-hosted, PayPal-specified, and form-gated for access; the evidence shows PayPal as an implementer of OpenAI's ACP and Google's UCP, not evidence that independent third parties (beyond PayPal/Braintree) have implemented PayPal's own agentic-commerce protocol or platform. No citation shows a separate company building a competing or parallel implementation of PayPal's cart API/Store Sync spec — missing for 10: any documented independent third-party implementer of PayPal's own agentic commerce protocol/platform, evidence of a multi-vendor standards body or spec governance, or a second payment processor adopting the same PayPal-defined API.
